open_points.subject: read_mark
open_points.text: read_mark: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST return None when _read_record gives None for _mark_path of the project id and source id, letting its DelivererError pass; otherwise it MUST return the PublicationMark those bytes hold only when they are one JSON text in UTF-8 without a byte-order mark, valid against = models.PublicationMark with no extra field, whose project_id and source_id are the given ones, and MUST raise the DelivererError _state_unavailable returns for any other content.
open_points.rule: Таблица выше — исчерпывающий список путей значения, и у каждого из них своя форма: перечисление называется адресом, константа поставщика — `the imported X constant`, настройка — полем объекта настроек.
open_points.question: Replace the inline `UTF-8` encoding value with the name of an imported provider constant and add that constant to the module's declared imports.
